snippet.title: Groundwork Simulator — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306540/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcement

Dig anywhere. Build your operation. Turn dirt into gold.
Welcome to Groundwork Simulator, an open-world heavy machinery simulator where every bucket changes the landscape.

Get behind the controls of excavators, wheel loaders, bulldozers and trucks. Cut into hillsides, clear obstacles and haul material as you transform untouched ground into a working site.
Drill to discover valuable deposits, set up your washing equipment and build the water systems that keep your operation running. Work at your own pace or team up with friends in co-op for up to 4 players.

• Dig anywhere and reshape the entire map
• Operate heavy machinery with realistic excavation physics
• Clear trees and make your own path
• Drill for deposits and process material for gold
• Build and manage pumps, hoses and water systems
• Transport your equipment between worksites
• Grow your company, solo or with friends

Follow Groundwork Simulator:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/groundworksimulator/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Groundwork-Simulator/61592264177927/
Website: http://groundworksimulator.com/

#GroundworkSimulator #SimulationGames #HeavyMachinery
